critical_path.sequence: Baseline Validation and Data Inventory → Exception Rule Engine Development → Integration and Pilot Deployment → Full Network Rollout and Ongoing Monitoring
hard_dependencies: Calendar Data Inventory must complete before Rule Engine Specification begins.
Rule Engine Specification must complete before Nightly Reconciliation Pipeline Integration begins.
Nightly Reconciliation Pipeline Integration must complete before Network-Wide Deployment begins.
soft_dependencies: Template Governance Audit can proceed in parallel with Calendar Data Inventory but cannot precede it.
Failure Handling and Diagnostic Logging can run in parallel with Pilot Run and Exception Review but must not block it.

derived_dates.label: End of Phase 2 (Exception Rule Engine Development)
Start of Phase 3 (Integration and Pilot Deployment)

critical_path.impact_on_critical_path: If any hard dependency is delayed by more than 3 days, the entire critical path must be recomputed.

decision_log.decision: The rule engine will generate a named rule for every skipped or merged slot, with evidence from the calendar file.
decision_log.information_needed: A list of all known exception types and their root causes (e.g., conflict, staff unavailability).
decision_log.impact_on_downstream_work: This decision enables the rule engine to generate meaningful exception entries with traceability.

decision_log.decision: All messages must pass an eighth-grade readability test before delivery.
decision_log.deciding_role: David Chen, Plain-Language Review Board Chair
decision_log.information_needed: A list of all message templates and their Flesch-Kincaid scores from the review board archive.
decision_log.impact_on_downstream_work: This decision blocks any template approval without readability compliance; it must be enforced before message delivery.

decision_log.decision: The system will halt on any input that cannot be classified (e.g., missing date, invalid time).
decision_log.information_needed: A list of all valid calendar entry formats and required fields.
decision_log.impact_on_downstream_work: This decision prevents silent drops or guessed mappings; it blocks the integration pipeline until input validation is complete.

decision_log.decision: The reconciliation audit must verify that all 4,100 appointments are accounted for in the exception report.
decision_log.information_needed: A master list of all appointment slots with date and time from raw exports.
decision_log.impact_on_downstream_work: This decision ensures that no appointments are lost or unaccounted for; it must be verified before full rollout.
